statements: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "search_index_fts" USING fts5(title, body, comments, files, ref, source_table UNINDEXED, source_key UNINDEXED, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 0')

CREATE TRIGGER "search_index_fts_insert" AFTER INSERT ON "search_index" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  -- An index row's words (D186).
  INSERT INTO "search_index_fts" (title, body, comments, files, ref, source_table, source_key)
    VALUES (NEW.title, NEW.body, NEW.comments, NEW.files, 'r' || hex(NEW.source_table || char(31) || NEW.source_key), NEW.source_table, NEW.source_key);
END

CREATE TRIGGER "search_index_fts_update" AFTER UPDATE OF title, body, comments, files, source_table, source_key ON "search_index" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  -- An index row's words, written again (D186).
  DELETE FROM "search_index_fts" WHERE "search_index_fts" MATCH 'ref : "' || 'r' || hex(OLD.source_table || char(31) || OLD.source_key) || '"';
  INSERT INTO "search_index_fts" (title, body, comments, files, ref, source_table, source_key)
    VALUES (NEW.title, NEW.body, NEW.comments, NEW.files, 'r' || hex(NEW.source_table || char(31) || NEW.source_key), NEW.source_table, NEW.source_key);
END

CREATE TRIGGER "search_index_fts_delete" AFTER DELETE ON "search_index" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  -- An index row's words, deleted with it (D186).
  DELETE FROM "search_index_fts" WHERE "search_index_fts" MATCH 'ref : "' || 'r' || hex(OLD.source_table || char(31) || OLD.source_key) || '"';
END

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_document_audience_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "document" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named', 'inherit')
  OR NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none')
  OR NEW."effective_audience" IS NOT CASE NEW."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN NEW."created_by" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."created_by") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT NEW."created_by" AS value WHERE NEW."created_by" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE(NEW."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN NEW."folder_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = NEW."folder_id") THEN (SELECT audience_parent."effective_audience" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = NEW."folder_id") ELSE CASE WHEN NEW."created_by" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."created_by") END END END
  OR NEW."effective_agents" IS NOT CASE WHEN NEW."audience" = 'inherit' AND NEW."folder_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = NEW."folder_id") AND CASE (SELECT audience_parent."effective_agents" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = NEW."folder_id") WHEN 'followRole' THEN 0 WHEN 'readOnly' THEN 1 WHEN 'none' THEN 2 END > CASE NEW."agent_access" WHEN 'followRole' THEN 0 WHEN 'readOnly' THEN 1 WHEN 'none' THEN 2 END THEN (SELECT audience_parent."effective_agents" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = NEW."folder_id") ELSE NEW."agent_access" END
BEGIN
  -- The @audience of Document (D156, D182): the row's audience resolved into
  -- effective_audience and effective_agents, whatever writes the row.
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document.audience is none of everyone, private, named, inherit') WHERE NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named', 'inherit');
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document.agent_access is none of followRole, readOnly, none') WHERE NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none');
  UPDATE "document" SET "effective_audience" = CASE "document"."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN "document"."created_by" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("document"."created_by") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT "document"."created_by" AS value WHERE "document"."created_by" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE("document"."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN "document"."folder_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") THEN (SELECT audience_parent."effective_audience" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") ELSE CASE WHEN "document"."created_by" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("document"."created_by") END END END,
    "effective_agents" = CASE WHEN "document"."audience" = 'inherit' AND "document"."folder_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") AND CASE (SELECT audience_parent."effective_agents" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") WHEN 'followRole' THEN 0 WHEN 'readOnly' THEN 1 WHEN 'none' THEN 2 END > CASE "document"."agent_access" WHEN 'followRole' THEN 0 WHEN 'readOnly' THEN 1 WHEN 'none' THEN 2 END THEN (SELECT audience_parent."effective_agents" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") ELSE "document"."agent_access" END
    WHERE "document"."id" = NEW."id";
END
triggers.name: trg_document_audience_update

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_folder_audience_cascade" AFTER UPDATE ON "folder" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."effective_audience" IS NOT OLD."effective_audience" OR NEW."effective_agents" IS NOT OLD."effective_agents"
BEGIN
  -- The children that inherit the audience of Folder (D156, D182), resolved
  -- again when its own resolved audience changes.
  UPDATE "document" SET "effective_audience" = CASE "document"."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN "document"."created_by" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("document"."created_by") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT "document"."created_by" AS value WHERE "document"."created_by" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE("document"."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN "document"."folder_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") THEN (SELECT audience_parent."effective_audience" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") ELSE CASE WHEN "document"."created_by" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("document"."created_by") END END END,
    "effective_agents" = CASE WHEN "document"."audience" = 'inherit' AND "document"."folder_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") AND CASE (SELECT audience_parent."effective_agents" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") WHEN 'followRole' THEN 0 WHEN 'readOnly' THEN 1 WHEN 'none' THEN 2 END > CASE "document"."agent_access" WHEN 'followRole' THEN 0 WHEN 'readOnly' THEN 1 WHEN 'none' THEN 2 END THEN (SELECT audience_parent."effective_agents" FROM "folder" AS audience_parent WHERE audience_parent."id" = "document"."folder_id") ELSE "document"."agent_access" END
    WHERE "document"."audience" = 'inherit' AND "document"."folder_id" = NEW."id";
END

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_folder_audience_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "folder" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named')
  OR NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none')
  OR NEW."effective_audience" IS NOT CASE NEW."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN NEW."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."owner") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT NEW."owner" AS value WHERE NEW."owner" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE(NEW."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN NEW."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."owner") END END
  OR NEW."effective_agents" IS NOT NEW."agent_access"
BEGIN
  -- The @audience of Folder (D156, D182): the row's audience resolved into
  -- effective_audience and effective_agents, whatever writes the row.
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'folder.audience is none of everyone, private, named') WHERE NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named');
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'folder.agent_access is none of followRole, readOnly, none') WHERE NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none');
  UPDATE "folder" SET "effective_audience" = CASE "folder"."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN "folder"."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("folder"."owner") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT "folder"."owner" AS value WHERE "folder"."owner" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE("folder"."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN "folder"."owner" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("folder"."owner") END END,
    "effective_agents" = "folder"."agent_access"
    WHERE "folder"."id" = NEW."id";
END
triggers.name: trg_folder_audience_update
